schemes.apiKeyQuery.description: "Legacy: the user's `api_key` as a query parameter, together with an `app_key`. Existing integrations keep working; prefer an API token, or at least the header form, so no credential appears in a URL."
schemes.appKeyHeader.description: "The registered integration's `app_key`, sent as a header. Needed alongside a JWT or a legacy `api_key`; API tokens need no `app_key`."
schemes.appKeyQuery.description: "Legacy: the registered integration's `app_key` as a query parameter. Existing integrations keep working; prefer the `app-key` header."
schemes.bearerAuth.description: "An API token (`pcrm_live_...`), a JWT, or a legacy `api_key`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <credential>`. The three are told apart by shape."
